symptoms: Checkout requests timing out, 5xx rate at 38%, alert: payments-api p99 latency > 8s
logs:
ERROR redis.exceptions.ConnectionError: Too many connections
WARN pool exhausted, waiting for free connection (timeout=5000ms)
root_cause: Redis connection pool exhausted after a traffic spike from a flash sale; pool max_connections was 50
fix_applied: Increased Redis pool max_connections from 50 to 200 and restarted payments-api workers

symptoms: Users randomly logged out, spike in 401 responses
logs:
ERROR jwt.exceptions.ExpiredSignatureError: Signature has expired
WARN clock skew detected between auth-service pods: 94s
root_cause: NTP drift on one node caused JWT validation to fail on tokens issued by other pods
fix_applied: Restarted the auth-service pods only (no clock fix)

symptoms: Same random logouts returned two hours after restart
logs: WARN clock skew detected between auth-service pods: 102s
root_cause: NTP drift on node ip-10-0-3-17 (chrony service stopped)
fix_applied: Restarted chrony on the node and cordoned it until time synced
